purpose: Allow MorroWise to request local proactive notifications without granting a background process permission to execute or mutate $COLLAB files.

outbox.rule: Agent-owned code may append notification data only. It must not send notifications, execute shell commands, or mutate delivered state.

implementation_choice.label: Small local app with file picker grant
implementation_choice.authorization: Vincent selects exactly one outbox file via file picker
implementation_choice.reason: This keeps $COLLAB in Downloads, avoids /bin/bash or launchd broad access, and prevents Agent-owned scripts from becoming executable delivery code.

notifier_state.rule: Delivered marks belong to the trusted Notifier, not to $COLLAB. The Notifier must not write back to the shared source tree.

rate_limit.overflow_rule: Deliver max_per_minute - 1 direct notifications, then emit one merged digest for the remaining eligible notifications.
rate_limit.dedupe_rule: Trusted Notifier skips entries whose id or dedupe_key is already present in its delivered store.

allowed: append one JSONL line to the outbox
create the outbox directory if missing
forbidden: run node as a delivery action

allowed: read the single outbox file granted by Vincent
write delivered mark to Notifier app storage
apply ttl, dedupe, rate limit, and merge rules
forbidden: open action URLs from notification payloads

checks: levels and text lengths are bounded
writer appends JSONL instead of rewriting
overflow notifications are merged after rate limit
trusted Notifier spec forbids shell, node, git, $COLLAB writes, and deletion
writer does not import child_process or call delivery tools
CLI can queue to a caller-provided outbox path without sending
